author.heading: About Unknown
author.bio: The creator of this exact English wording has not been established. Teresa of Ávila (1515–1582), the person named in the attribution, was a Spanish Carmelite reformer and spiritual writer whose major works include The Life, The Way of Perfection and The Interior Castle. A modern English quotation credit needs an identifiable textual link to those writings.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The available source trail reaches a modern inspirational quotation collection rather than Teresa’s own text. Her writings do discuss suffering within religious life, but similarity of subject cannot authenticate an isolated maxim. The sentence is therefore presented as an unconfirmed credit, without treating it as a medical claim.
